name: diffrail
description: Checks repository changes against declared task boundaries before merge.

interface.longDescription: Check repository changes against explicit file boundaries for the task assigned by the user or a trusted workflow. DiffRail distinguishes ordinary files, shared contracts, and protected paths, and can check against policy from a trusted Git base revision. Requires Git, the separately installed DiffRail CLI, and a host that can run local terminal commands in the repository. This skills-only plugin guides the workflow; the CLI performs the check. It does not sandbox file access, authenticate task assignment, detect semantic conflicts, or run project tests. The installed CLI makes no network calls.
defaultPrompt: Check this repository's changes against the task boundary I assigned.
